# arioso

> Make tunes


## Pages in this subsection

- [arioso](arioso.html.md): Arioso - Unified facade for AI music generation platforms.
- [arioso.base](arioso.base.html.md): Core types and constants for arioso.
- [arioso.named_prompts](arioso.named_prompts.html.md): Named prompts: a ledger of (name, prompt_text) pairs organized by category.
- [arioso.platforms](arioso.platforms.html.md): Platform packages for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.beatoven](arioso.platforms.beatoven.html.md): Beatoven.ai platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.beatoven.adapter](arioso.platforms.beatoven.adapter.html.md): Beatoven.ai adapter via REST API.
- [arioso.platforms.beatoven.config](arioso.platforms.beatoven.config.html.md): Beatoven.ai platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.elevenlabs](arioso.platforms.elevenlabs.html.md): ElevenLabs Music platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.elevenlabs.adapter](arioso.platforms.elevenlabs.adapter.html.md): ElevenLabs Music adapter.
- [arioso.platforms.elevenlabs.config](arioso.platforms.elevenlabs.config.html.md): ElevenLabs Music platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.harmonai](arioso.platforms.harmonai.html.md): Harmonai (Dance Diffusion) platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.harmonai.adapter](arioso.platforms.harmonai.adapter.html.md): Harmonai (Dance Diffusion) adapter using diffusers.
- [arioso.platforms.harmonai.config](arioso.platforms.harmonai.config.html.md): Harmonai (Dance Diffusion) platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.jen](arioso.platforms.jen.html.md): Jen platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.jen.adapter](arioso.platforms.jen.adapter.html.md): Jen adapter via REST API.
- [arioso.platforms.jen.config](arioso.platforms.jen.config.html.md): Jen platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.loudly](arioso.platforms.loudly.html.md): Loudly platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.loudly.adapter](arioso.platforms.loudly.adapter.html.md): Loudly adapter via REST API.
- [arioso.platforms.loudly.config](arioso.platforms.loudly.config.html.md): Loudly platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.lyria2](arioso.platforms.lyria2.html.md): Google Lyria 2 platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.lyria2.adapter](arioso.platforms.lyria2.adapter.html.md): Google Lyria 2 adapter.
- [arioso.platforms.lyria2.config](arioso.platforms.lyria2.config.html.md): Google Lyria 2 platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.lyria_rt](arioso.platforms.lyria_rt.html.md): Google Lyria RealTime platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.lyria_rt.adapter](arioso.platforms.lyria_rt.adapter.html.md): Google Lyria RealTime adapter using the google-genai SDK.
- [arioso.platforms.lyria_rt.config](arioso.platforms.lyria_rt.config.html.md): Google Lyria RealTime platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.mubert](arioso.platforms.mubert.html.md): Mubert platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.mubert.adapter](arioso.platforms.mubert.adapter.html.md): Mubert adapter via REST API.
- [arioso.platforms.mubert.config](arioso.platforms.mubert.config.html.md): Mubert platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.musicgen](arioso.platforms.musicgen.html.md): MusicGen platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.musicgen.adapter](arioso.platforms.musicgen.adapter.html.md): MusicGen adapter using audiocraft (preferred) or transformers.
- [arioso.platforms.musicgen.config](arioso.platforms.musicgen.config.html.md): MusicGen platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.riffusion](arioso.platforms.riffusion.html.md): Riffusion platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.riffusion.adapter](arioso.platforms.riffusion.adapter.html.md): Riffusion adapter using the riffusion library or diffusers fallback.
- [arioso.platforms.riffusion.config](arioso.platforms.riffusion.config.html.md): Riffusion platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.stable_audio](arioso.platforms.stable_audio.html.md): Stable Audio Open platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.stable_audio.adapter](arioso.platforms.stable_audio.adapter.html.md): Stable Audio Open adapter using HuggingFace Diffusers.
- [arioso.platforms.stable_audio.config](arioso.platforms.stable_audio.config.html.md): Stable Audio Open platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.sunoapi](arioso.platforms.sunoapi.html.md): Suno platform (via sunoapi.org) for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.sunoapi.adapter](arioso.platforms.sunoapi.adapter.html.md): Suno adapter via sunoapi.org REST API.
- [arioso.platforms.sunoapi.config](arioso.platforms.sunoapi.config.html.md): Suno (via sunoapi.org) platform configuration.
- [arioso.platforms.sunoapi.task_store](arioso.platforms.sunoapi.task_store.html.md): Local task store for Suno API requests.
- [arioso.platforms.udio](arioso.platforms.udio.html.md): Udio platform (via UdioWrapper) for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.udio.adapter](arioso.platforms.udio.adapter.html.md): Udio adapter via udio-wrapper (unofficial).
- [arioso.platforms.udio.config](arioso.platforms.udio.config.html.md): Udio platform configuration (via udio-wrapper).
- [arioso.platforms.yue](arioso.platforms.yue.html.md): YuE platform for arioso.
- [arioso.platforms.yue.adapter](arioso.platforms.yue.adapter.html.md): YuE adapter supporting fal.ai REST API and local CLI backends.
- [arioso.platforms.yue.config](arioso.platforms.yue.config.html.md): YuE platform configuration.
- [arioso.registry](arioso.registry.html.md): Platform registry with auto-discovery and lazy loading.
- [arioso.services](arioso.services.html.md): Lazy mapping of platform names to &#96;ServiceHandle&#96; objects.
- [arioso.tools](arioso.tools.html.md): High-level tools for common arioso workflows (submit, poll, download).
- [arioso.translation](arioso.translation.html.md): Parameter translation layer.
